DateWindow.description: When to travel: fixed dates, or a month and a number of nights.

exact_end.description: Fixed dates: last day of the trip, YYYY-MM-DD, on or after exact_start (the same day for a day trip).

exact_start.description: Fixed dates: first day of the trip, YYYY-MM-DD, after today. Set with exact_end; leave month and nights empty.

month.description: Flexible dates: the month to leave in, YYYY-MM (e.g. '2026-11'), this month or later. Set with nights; leave exact_start and exact_end empty.

nights.description: Flexible dates: number of nights, 1 to 119. Set with month.

DateWindow.title: DateWindow

age.description: Age in years, required for a child (0-17); empty for an adult.

description: A trip request: where from, where to (or "suggest one"), when, who, and the budget.

budget_eur.description: Total budget in whole euro for the whole party: travel, lodging, activities; at most 50000.

dates.description: Fixed dates, or a month and a number of nights.

destination.description: Where to go: a city, region or country. Empty when suggest_destination is true.

destination_idea.description: Only with suggest_destination: what the trip should be like, e.g. 'mare a novembre, volo diretto'. Ignored (dropped) when suggest_destination is false.

origin.description: Where the trip starts: a city or an IATA airport code, e.g. 'Milano', 'MXP'.

preferences.description: Free-text preferences, e.g. 'niente voli prima delle 8, cucina locale'.

suggest_destination.description: True to let the planner choose the destination (up to three candidates, with reasons); destination must then be empty.

travelers.description: Everyone travelling (1-9 people): at least one adult; children with age.

title: PlanRequest

x-error-codes.adult_age_not_allowed: age is only for children; leave it empty for adults
x-error-codes.adult_required: at least one adult must travel
x-error-codes.dates_conflict: choose either fixed dates (exact_start, exact_end) or flexible dates (month, nights), not both
x-error-codes.dates_required: choose fixed dates (exact_start and exact_end) or flexible dates (month and nights)
x-error-codes.destination_conflict: give either a destination or suggest_destination, not both
x-error-codes.destination_required: give a destination, or set suggest_destination to let the planner choose
x-error-codes.end_before_start: exact_end ({exact_end}) must be on or after exact_start ({exact_start})
x-error-codes.invalid_month: month '{month}' is not a month: use YYYY-MM with MM 01-12
x-error-codes.month_in_past: month {month} is in the past: choose {current_month} or later
x-error-codes.trip_too_long: the trip can last at most {max_days} days ({max_nights} nights), got {nights} nights
